assertions.subject: Osteomyelitis
assertions.comparator: children younger than 12 to 18 months of age
assertions.quote: In children younger than 12 to 18 months of age, capillaries perforate the epiphyseal growth plate, permitting spread of infection across the epiphysis leading to suppurative arthritis

assertions.subject: Sickle cell disease
assertions.quote: Bone infections in children with sickle cell disease occur in the diaphyseal portion of the long bones, probably as a consequence of antecedent focal infarction
